description: Claim one copy of a stack (holding_id, from row_copies) for a deck (id or name), as allocate does with quantity 1: shared:true borrows a copy another deck claims, disclosed on both sides (relay also_allocated_to and physically_in). A proxy is refused onto a tournament deck. On a tournament deck a real copy replaces one of the card's proxies past the list's count (proxies_replaced, released: relay them; a sleeved proxy is recorded back in "Unsorted", so tell the user to take it out of the deck box).

deck.description: The deck that claims the copy: id or name

shared.description: Borrow a copy another deck claims; default false

name: claim_copy
title: Claim copy
